description_en: Saves and publishes the application configuration
kebab_example: aliyun green publish-app-config --app-id txt_check_agent_01 --config '{"agentItemConfigs": "[{\"agentId\":\"ag.abcxxx\",\"enable\":true,\"name\":\"智能体1\"}]"}' --agent-id ag.abcxxx --agent-name '智能体1' --enable true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type agent_text --api-version 2022-09-26 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PublishAppConfig

parameters.help_en: The application ID. This parameter must be the AppId returned by the AddAppConfig operation after the application is created
parameters.help_zh: App ID。本参数必须来自前置 API AddAppConfig 创建 App 后返回的 AppId
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration details. The value is a JSON string. The outer object contains the agentItemConfigs field, and its value is a re-serialized JSON array string (a double-nested structure) represented as a sequence of characters. Each array element in agentItemConfigs is an agent configuration object. Supported fields include agentId (string, the agent ID. Use the actual value returned by AddAppAgent or a clear placeholder such as <your-agent-id>), name (string, the agent name), and enable (boolean, specifies whether to enable the agent). Differences and connections with the Config parameter of ModifyAppAgent: The Config parameter of ModifyAppAgent describes the runtime configuration of a single agent (model, scene, or labelConfig), and you must first configure the agent by calling ModifyAppAgent. The Config parameter of this operation aggregates all agent entries (agentItemConfigs) under the application for overall publishing
parameters.help_zh: 配置详情。取值为 JSON 字符串：外层对象包含 agentItemConfigs 字段，其值是再次序列化后的 JSON 数组字符串（双重嵌套结构）。agentItemConfigs 数组元素为智能体配置对象，支持字段：agentId（string，智能体 ID，请使用 AddAppAgent 返回的真实值或形如 <your-agent-id> 的明确占位符）、name（string，智能体名称）、enable（boolean，是否启用该智能体）。与 ModifyAppAgent 的 Config 区别与联系：ModifyAppAgent 的 Config 描述单个智能体的运行配置（model/scene/labelConfig），需先通过 ModifyAppAgent 完成配置；本接口 Config 汇总 App 下全部智能体条目（agentItemConfigs）用于整体发布
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en: The agent ID. This parameter must be the AgentId returned by the AddAppAgent operation after the agent is added
parameters.help_zh: Agent ID。本参数必须来自前置 API AddAppAgent 添加智能体后返回的 AgentId
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the agent. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用。取值：
true：启用
false：禁用
parameters.name: enable
